5. **Replace:** the restored case is re-exported through the same real path, then imported with Replace selected and the title typed. Wrong/empty confirmation writes nothing (snapshot equality); the correct title replaces transactionally. Exactly one case with the target title remains, same case ID as the copy, fresh child IDs, identical data, decoy untouched, no orphan rows.
6. **UI proof:** both shared-in images render (`naturalWidth > 0`, `complete`) and every tag is visible on card detail after copy and after replace.
